# VAMA Consulting Group

> Two practices. Immigration Business Documents: business plans, financial models, market analysis, org charts, economic impact studies (BLS-based Type I method), and RFE audits prepared for U.S. immigration counsel (E-2, L-1, EB-1C, EB-2 NIW, EB-1A, EB-5). VAMA is not a law firm. AI Operations and Growth: a fixed-scope Revenue Leakage Audit of one business workflow, $3,500-$5,000, with a 90-day roadmap; implementation optional.

- Immigration inquiries: immigration@vamacg.com
- AI operations inquiries: aiconsulting@vamacg.com

## Pages

- [About Andrija Popović and VAMA Consulting Group](https://vamacg.com/about/): VAMA Consulting Group is led by Andrija Popović, an economist and PhD candidate in macroeconomics who has consulted since 2018 and personally leads every immigration documentation engagement and every workflow audit.
- [Book a 20-Minute Fit Call - AI Revenue Leakage Audit](https://vamacg.com/ai-operations/book-fit-call/): Answer 5 quick questions and pick a time. A 20-minute call to decide whether a Revenue Leakage Audit of one workflow is worth it for your business.
- [AI Operations & Growth - Revenue Leakage Audit for Service Businesses](https://vamacg.com/ai-operations/): A fixed-scope audit of one workflow: interviews, a workflow and handoff map, a cost-of-delay range built from your numbers, improvement options compared on the same problem, and a 90-day roadmap that says what not to automate. $3,500-$5,000, about 10 business days.
- [Sample Revenue Leakage Audit - What the Deliverable Looks Like](https://vamacg.com/ai-operations/sample-audit/): An illustrative sample of the VAMA Revenue Leakage Audit for a fictional 11-person HVAC and plumbing company - process map, leak evidence, cost ranges, ranked options, what not to automate, and a 90-day roadmap.
- [Contact VAMA Consulting Group](https://vamacg.com/contact/): Choose your path - immigration business documents or AI operations - so your request reaches the right inbox with the right questions. Or send a general message.

Filter by visa category.

Counsel keeps strategy and the client relationship; VAMA carries the drafting. Start with one scoped pilot matter.

VAMA is not a law firm.

We reply within 1 business day with a yes, a no, or up to 5 clarifying questions. No confidential files through this form.
